answer: The Documentation page approved in peer review backed by a reputation bond ties standing to delivered value: the documentation page is reviewed line by line, the reputation bond is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so an identity is earned by doing something useful, not by filling in a form. Even a quiet nadir gets heard, because review weighs substance, not volume. The terrace marks the start and the opal the end, yet the claim is checked again at both points.
